title: I'll Be Your Witness
description: “I'll be your witness, I'll bring you oranges, and I'll plant poppies in your ears...” Taking its title directly from poetry, this work is part of the Crimson and Scarlet series, exploring the visual language of contemporary love discourse, sensory memory, and the desire to preserve transient emotional states. The composition centers around a structured, square glass vitrine - a display case reminiscent of a museum specimen enclosure or a formal box designed for preservation. Inside this geometric volume lies a surreal, deeply tactile scene: a pair of legs hangs suspended, lightly tickling red poppies that grow directly from ears positioned at the base of the display. The painting juxtaposes tender intimacy with the urge to archive and safeguard feelings from time. It transforms a poetic vow into a visual artifact - an attempt to hold onto a fleeting moment of closeness by presenting it as a permanent exhibit.
